claims.evidence: PRIDE organism NCBITaxon 10090; paper: Peli1 KO and WT mice.

claims.evidence: Brains harvested before immunization (0), 10 dpi (onset) and 20 dpi (peak); condition names 0/10/20 = days post immunization.

claims.value: normal (0 day) | experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (10, 20 day) | not applicable (reference pools)
claims.evidence: 0-day mice were euthanized before EAE immunization; 10/20 dpi mice were MOG35-55-immunized. PRIDE 'multiple sclerosis' not used: mice carry the EAE model, MONDO:0005134.
Only 'age- and sex-matched mice were used'; no values given.
All 176 raw headers read 'Orbitrap Elite MS'; PRIDE MS:1001910; live OLS label is 'Orbitrap Elite'.
Paper FASP: 'the protein to trypsin ratio was 50:1'; protocol: 'Trypsin was set as enzyme'. Reconcile 'cleavage_agent_unsupported' is a false positive.
Protocol: 'operated in the data-dependent-acquisition mode'; raw methods TOP10.
Lysis buffer contained 0.1 M DTT. Alkylation reagent not stated; column omitted.
Survey scans 300-2000 m/z; raw header scan event 'FTMS + p norm o(300.0-2000.0)'.

limitations: Individual-mouse membership of the TMT pools is not deposited, so TMT pool sources cannot be linked to the label-free individual-mouse sources.
Sex, age and developmental stage not reported per mouse (only 'age- and sex-matched'): not available.
Organism part encoded as cerebral hemisphere; the paper specifies the frontal part of the right hemisphere.
No search-engine parameter file (.msf/.pdResult) deposited; modifications and tolerances come from protocol text (TMT mods cross-checked in the peptide table).
Alkylation reagent not stated (carbamidomethylation searched); column omitted.
Precursor m/z selection window of each reference run (12 windows) is only in the file/assay name; no SDRF column for it.
Methods text says 24 reference runs; 26 deposited (two re-runs), all included.
